question: Does realized completed-cycle loss provide useful direction-specific information before the next BUY, beyond a pause that also changes the opportunity clock?
selection_history: Prior2024 entry damage and EX045 clock dependence already seen. Proposed before A's new preentry population/decomposition counts. No claim of pristine preregistration.

feedback_observation.available_when: Actual SELL fill has completed a real BUY-to-SELL cycle by D decision time; neither sell intent nor mark-to-market is completion
feedback_observation.net_per_unit: actual_exit_fill * 0.999 - actual_entry_fill * 1.001 on the original consistent projected price basis
feedback_observation.independent_requirement: Completed-cycle sign must match actual funded account fills and both-side fees, with execution price projection authenticated
feedback_observation.failed_BUY: Not a cycle, loss, or trigger

finite_pause.arming: Arm once after a real completion of selected sign; BASE never arms
finite_pause.consumption: Only at first subsequent original eligible flat BUY decision D after original reservation permits; consume the one armed pause
finite_pause.planned_slot: Set original reservation to D market-index i + 11, corresponding to hypothetical next E plus original H10 reservation
finite_pause.resume: At reservation expiry re-evaluate original entry normally; no continued veto based on stale last-loss sign
finite_pause.virtual_state: No actual BUY/SELL, position, entry price/deadline, fee, or trade return is invented
finite_pause.unfilled_opportunity: Pause may consume a candidate whose original BUY would not fill; never condition on the future fill outcome
finite_pause.counter: Do not count skipped slots as actual closed trades
